name: Explore a room
description: Cover a room from up to six viewpoints with a left/centre/right head sweep both ways; succeeds when at least 75 % of the room's furniture was seen. A piece of furniture counts once one of its support layers (top or shelf) is in view; seeing every shelf of one piece is explore_furniture.

verifier.name: room_explored
verifier.meaning: At least 75 % of the room's furniture was seen (one of its support layers in the head camera).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

relations.when: a specific object must then be located
every shelf of one piece of furniture must be seen
relations.reason: room coverage counts a piece once; its other layers may still hide objects

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
